keyFindings.description: Blocks: a semantic merge defect between main's LEGION-755 person-handover rows (admit.go:420, gate.go:574: todo observed from triage, backlog or icebox) and this branch's ISSUE_CHANGED retry. On a refusal, the retry calls statusStillWanted, which judges OutOfWorkflow(read.Status) - true for the very status the row was queued from - so the row finishes without writing ('its issue left the workflow'). Any comment or edit between the read and the write loses a person's handover; on the triage path applyRead's unprepared ReadIssue also queues a triage wake the controller's skill says to ignore. Probes: statuses=[] for triage, backlog and icebox; scratch Dispatch ends at triage with only a controller_notice triage row. Fix: judge a PersonHandover row's retry by its own rule (read still at ObservedStatus and HandedOver -> write again; label gone -> drop with the existing log), keep applyRead from waking the controller for it, and add a test whose fake refuses once, for both sources.
